audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Ziggs Level 1 and Level 6 outright and Gnar the 3 and 4-5 rows — the mirror settled every row differently, and the level-6 row was backwards on both sides.
audit.why: The mirror (gnar__ziggs) rebuilt the chart as Skill / Gnar / Skill / Skill / Gnar / Skill / Ziggs with ratings to match, and flagged Level 6 as the most damaging row: the content layer's own spikes[1] calls that window a one-combo kill on a champion with no dash, while the chart handed it to Ziggs.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed together as one atomic group across both layers, with ratings rebuilt: Skill rows 5/10, Gnar rows 4/10 and 3/10, the 2+ items row 6/10 to Ziggs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your Mega Inferno Bomb spike; nowhere did the matchup date a single cooldown.
audit.why: GNAR! is 90/60/30s at 590 range — it goes from a rare ultimate to a near-permanent threat by rank 3. Boomerang Throw is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at 1100 and refunds cooldown when caught; Hop/Crunch 22s down to 12s at 475; Wallop a flat 7s. Your Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s, Mega Inferno Bomb 120s at 5000.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is stated as Gnar's Rage window with the combo named, and the real GNAR! and Boomerang Throw timers are written into the prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly said your Q out-ranges him — the tldr, whys[1] and phases[0].why all built advice on it.
audit.why: Boomerang Throw is 1100 range against Bouncing Bomb's 850. Mini Gnar out-ranges you by 250 units, the reverse of what the page claimed, and catching the boomerang on the return cuts its cooldown further. Separately, both champions carry displacement — Satchel Charge's knockup against GNAR! — so whoever lands it first owns the trade, and you have no dash to fall back on.
audit.corrected: Range corrected everywhere it drove advice; the spacing rule becomes 'step up on his Q downtime' rather than 'out-range him', and the displacement race is stated.

edits.before: A real poke war — your Q out-ranges, his GNAR! (Mega) punishes. Trade bombs and dodge the answer.
edits.after: He out-ranges you 1100 to 850 — this is a spacing war you win on his Q downtime, not on range.

edits.before: Q bombs out-range every melee tool in the game — chunk Gnar on every last-hit attempt, but respect early minion aggro.
edits.after: Boomerang Throw reaches 1100 to your 850 — you do not out-range him, so step up only while it is down, 16s at rank 1.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: At full Rage: Crunch in, Wallop stun, GNAR! into a wall. You have no dash — hold Satchel and stay off terrain.

edits.before: Mini Gnar has no gap-closer and low resistances, so your Level 1 poke is free.
edits.after: Boomerang Throw is 1100 to your 850 — mini Gnar out-ranges your poke.

edits.before: At Level 2 you still out-range his Q Boomerang and shove him off farm safely.
edits.after: Level 2: he catches the boomerang to cut its 16s, and pokes you for free.

edits.before: Through Levels 4-5 you keep him in mini form and win every ranged exchange.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 hinge on his Rage bar — mini trades even, Mega ends you.

edits.before: At Level 6 your R adds burst while he still can't reliably reach you.
edits.after: At 6, Crunch into a Wallop stun into GNAR! on a wall kills you.

edits.before: On his first item Mega Gnar's wall-stun combo can delete you, flipping the lane.
edits.after: First item: the wall-stun still kills, but GNAR! is 90s at rank 1 — punish that.

edits.before: With two items his GNAR! engage threat outweighs your poke in every skirmish.
edits.after: With two items you siege from 850 and R from 5000 while he needs 590.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are pure poke: mini Gnar has no gap-closer besides E Hop and low resistances, so your Short Fuse autos and Bouncing Bomb chunk him with zero risk while you shove and deny CS.
edits.after: Boomerang Throw reaches 1100 to your 850, so levels 1-2 are not free poke — he pokes you. It is 16s at rank 1 and he cuts it by catching the return, so stand where the boomerang cannot clip you twice.

edits.before: This is Gnar's window: at 100 Rage he transforms into Mega Gnar and can flash-GNAR! stun you into a wall, so hold W to reposition and never stand near terrain when his Rage bar is full.
edits.after: This is Gnar's window: at full Rage, Crunch (E) into a Wallop (W) stun into GNAR! (R) on a wall, and GNAR! is 90s at rank 1 but 30s at max. You have no dash — hold Satchel Charge and stay off terrain.

edits.before: Space so his Q Boomerang can't hit you on the return
edits.after: Landing Satchel Charge before he lands GNAR! in a wall

notes: The 'your Q out-ranges' framing was the load-bearing error here, same shape as the Galio page: Boomerang Throw is 1100 against Bouncing Bomb's 850, so mini Gnar out-ranges you by 250 units. Not asserted because Riot's text does not answer it: whether Satchel Charge's self-knockback can be used mid-GNAR! to change which wall you hit, and whether Hexplosive Minefield mines survive Mega Gnar's Crunch landing.
